description_en: Resets the password that a client account uses to log on to the Smart Access Gateway (SAG) app
description_zh: 调用ResetSmartAccessGatewayClientUserPassword重置智能接入网关APP客户端密码
kebab_example: aliyun smartag reset-smart-access-gateway-client-user-password --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --smart-ag-id sag-kzo5dvms3dqii30000 --user-name username --region cn-hangzhou
name: ResetSmartAccessGatewayClientUserPassword

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the SAG app instance is deployed
parameters.help_zh: 智能接入网关App实例所属的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAG app instance
parameters.name: smart_ag_id

parameters.help_en: The username of the client account for which you want to reset the password
parameters.help_zh: 待重置密码的客户端的用户名
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en:
The new password.

If you do not specify a new password, the system generates a random password.

If you specify a new password, the password is reset to the specified new password.

    The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), at signs (@), periods (.), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter or a digit.

After the password is reset, an email that contains the new password is sent to the email address of the client account
parameters.help_zh:
客户端的新密码。

如果您不输入本参数，系统将随机生成一个新密码。
如果您输入本参数，则表示您自定义新密码。
        
        密码长度为8~32个字符，必须以大小写字母或数字开头，可以包含下划线（_） 、at（@）和短划线（-）。

系统重置密码后，会通过邮件向您发送新的密码
parameters.name: password
